# Louis

> Louis turns YouTube into audio playlists for your Yoto. Link a playlist to a physical Make Your Own (MYO) card in the Yoto app.

Louis is an open-source desktop and self-hosted app for personal use. Search YouTube or paste a video, playlist, or channel URL, arrange a playlist, then Update — Louis downloads and transcodes. Physical MYO card linking stays in the Yoto app.

## Product

- Search YouTube; paste a video, Shorts, playlist, or channel URL
- Playlist artwork (generate / upload / crop) and per-track 16×16 art (Yoto library, yotoicons.com, or draw)
- Trim a YouTube source; videos over 55 minutes auto-split into connected parts
- Optional loudness normalize for newly downloaded tracks
- Desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel) and Windows
- Same experience via Docker / GHCR (`ghcr.io/stuartromanek/louis`) or Home Assistant add-on
- Phone UI when self-hosted on the LAN (Search / Library / Add to playlist)
- Desktop local server: `http://127.0.0.1:4010`
- Docker / Home Assistant: port `4000` (not Home Assistant ingress)
- Bundled yt-dlp and ffmpeg in the desktop app
- First-run setup: prefer **Use default client** for Yoto (public PKCE); a YouTube Data API v3 key is recommended (faster search) but optional — Skip uses bundled yt-dlp
- Builds are currently unsigned (Gatekeeper / SmartScreen expected)

## Installers (GitHub Releases)

- macOS Apple Silicon: `Louis-<version>-arm64.dmg`
- macOS Intel: `Louis-<version>-x64.dmg`
- Windows: `Louis-Setup-<version>.exe`

Site download buttons resolve the latest assets dynamically via the GitHub Releases API.

## Personal use

Personal use only. You are responsible for complying with YouTube’s Terms of Service and applicable law when downloading audio.
